text:
deploy-bot: Promotion paused for chart release: service-payments v2.14.3 -> v2.15.0. Reason: ambiguous image tag 'staging-202603' found in values for container 'processor'. deploy-bot: Detected in eu-west change window (2026-03-05 22:00-23:00 UTC). Auto-promotion blocked by lockfile.

alice: oh, ambiguous tag again. did the image digest get published?

ben: I see two images with that tag in the registry (one pushed 10m ago, one 2h ago). bad. we shouldn't promote until we pin digest.

carol: can we fallback to the last stable chart (v2.14.3) and promote that instead of blocking the window?

samir: risk: rolling back to v2.14.3 loses minor config change in values (redis pool sizing). not ideal for payments.

alice: options: 1) pin image by digest and continue, 2) rollback to v2.14.3 for window, 3) manual override of deploy-bot with release-manager approval.

release-manager: prefer pin-by-digest + smoke test then promote. manual override only if pin impossible.

ben: I can grab the correct digest from staging. running `regctl` now.

ben: found digest: sha256:8a7b...f3c2 (pushed 2h ago). That matches the QA run we validated yesterday.

alice: great. who's going to update the helm values? it's a small change: replace `image.tag: staging-202603` with `image.digest: sha256:8a7b...f3c2` and keep tag for readability.

carol: I'll open a quick PR to override the values via the release overlay: `overlays/payments/pin-image.yaml` with `image.digest`. will request review.

samir: deploy-bot note: changes to values during a promotion window create a new lockfile entry. we need to annotate the release with `release.redwood/force-smoke: "true"` to trigger the manual smoke job.

alice: good call. smoke tests: payments smoke-suite -> /smoke/payments. we should run them after the image-pin PR merges.

release-manager: assemble release notes: include note about pinning digest due to ambiguous tag. add link to PR and to registry diff. I can do that after PR merge.

ben: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/payments/PR-842 — includes `image.digest` override and a short changelog.

carol: review requested from @alice and @samir. CI passing on the chart lint and unit tests.

alice: lgtm, approve.

deploy-bot: Received new commit on branch `pin-image-digest-842`. Creating locked promotion candidate. To continue promotion, add annotation: `helm.redwood/allow-promotion: "pin-digest-842"` to the release object, or run `/deploy override pin-digest-842` in thread by release-manager.

release-manager: doing `/deploy override pin-digest-842` now (manual command).

deploy-bot: Override accepted from @release-manager. Promotion resumed with pinned digest sha256:8a7b...f3c2. Starting canary (5% traffic) in eu-west.

samir: monitoring: initiating smoke job `smoke/payments` against canary endpoint. logs: `curl -sS https://eu-west.payments.canary/health | jq .status`

(smoke job output)
```
2026-03-05T22:07:12Z  OK
2026-03-05T22:07:13Z  payment-processor connected to redis (pool=6)
2026-03-05T22:07:15Z  latency P95=120ms
```

carol: smoke looks green. any anomaly in traces? tracing shows small spike in db connections but within expected.

ben: rolling out to 50% now. tracker: #DEVOPS-1234 updated with rollout steps and digests.

alice: reminder: update the release notes with line: `Pinned image for service-payments to sha256:8a7b...f3c2 due to ambiguous tag staging-202603 in registry; smoke tests passed.`

release-manager: notes written, pushing final promote. deploy-bot: please finish rollout and close lockfile entry.

deploy-bot: Promotion completed to 100% in eu-west. Lockfile entry `pin-digest-842` closed. Auto rollback triggers remain configured (error threshold 3% over 2m).

samir: I'll watch metrics for next 30m, but good to go. thanks team :tada:

carol: filing follow-up: we should add CI guard to prevent identical tags being reused in registry within 24h. filed ticket #INFRA-559.

alice: and add a small docs blurb in runbook about `deploy-bot` override steps.

release-manager: closing thread. final artifacts: PR-842, #DEVOPS-1234, #INFRA-559. :white_check_mark:
